messages:
samir: Quick proposal — add a burn-rate guard for rollouts that watches per-tenant token burn over a rolling window and proactively pauses when projected monthly spend would exceed committed budget. Main goals: reduce surprise bills, avoid noisy fallbacks, and give a clear telemetry signal for postmortems.

samir: Sketch of the guard config (draft):
```yaml
guard_type: burn_rate
metric: token_count_rate
window: 15m
threshold: 2.5x_baseline
predictive: true # run EWMA projection to next 24h
action: soft_pause
cooldown: 30m
reason_codes: [projected_overrun, sustained_spike]
```

maya: who is the baseline computed per-tenant or global? also how do we handle cold-start traffic (big spikes on first day)?

samir: baseline = per-tenant rolling median over last 7d (weekday-aware). For cold-start we fallback to tier-level baseline and require >3 consecutive windows before predictive pause.

jin: UX Q — if the guard triggers soft_pause, what does the console show? is it a full stop or traffic divert? can an engineer override from the UI?

samir: idea: soft_pause = divert 90% -> lower-cost model variant and 10% stays on new model for fidelity checks. Console shows explanatory banner + reason code and one-click manual resume with audit. Manual override stamped with user id and expires after cooldown.

ops-bot: [automated] rollout 0f3a paused by burn_rate guard for tenant acme-inc — reason=projected_overrun — link=https://console/redwood/rollouts/0f3a

sophie: worried about false positives if a tenant legitimately spikes (marketing campaign). Can we combine with latency/error SLO checks so we don't pause when requests are healthy?

elin: on telemetry naming: recommend stable event names so metrics dashboards don't break. e.g. rollout.autopause.v1 with tags: {tenant, reason_code, predicted_overrun_pct, baseline, window_secs}. Also add rollout.autopause.evaluation with the EWMA inputs so we can debug projections.

tomas: we should also expose a /simulate endpoint so customers and SEs can run their traffic trace through the guard and see estimated outcome. Add param cooldown_override=true for admins only.

maya: logging: when autopause happens include the token burn series for the last 6 windows and the EWMA projection in the log blob. That helped us debug a similar issue before. Also let's rate-limit autopause alerts (1 per tenant per 12h) to reduce noise.

samir: agree on telemetry names and simulation endpoint. Action items: samir (design guard config + API), elin (telemetry schema), tomas (simulate endpoint + RBAC), jin (console banner + override UX), maya (alert rate-limit). Can folks react if that's OK?

maya: +1 :thumbsup:

jin: +1

elin: noted, will post schema draft by EOD tomorrow

tomas: starting proto today, will ping when ready for walk-through

samir: thanks — I'll file a short RFC and link here. If anyone wants stricter pause behavior we can add a rollout-level flag to opt-out of soft_pause.

sophie: small nit — include 'grace_tokens' param so occasional bursts don't immediately count toward projection.

samir: good call, will add grace_tokens to config. Closing the thread for now while we iterate on RFC.
